parameters.name: --mode
parameters.description: Measure the peak (maximum). The value "minimum" has moved to the iperf-throughput sensor.

parameters.name: --measure-every-minutes
parameters.description: Minimum minutes between two real measurements.

parameters.name: --timeout-seconds
parameters.description: The time budget for the whole test in seconds.

parameters.name: --server
parameters.description: Pin the test to one speedtest.net server ID.

parameters.name: --source
parameters.description: Source address the measurement binds to.

parameters.name: --no-secure
parameters.description: Use HTTP instead of HTTPS towards speedtest.net.

parameters.name: --self-check
parameters.description: Only verify that the sensor is able to run.
